basic_info.description: This spacious full floor condo offers period charm, a great floor plan and convenience in the heart of the Central Richmond District. Set in a two-unit boutique building, this generously sized condominium consists of 2 bedrooms + sunroom, 1 split bath with a layout that flows seamlessly from room to room. Large bay windows and newly refinished hardwood floors create a warm inviting space.  The heart of the home is the huge living room that flows contiguously to the dining room and into the updated kitchen which benefits from stainless steel appliances, new quartz countertops and good storage. For your convenience, the condo offers in-unit laundry, 1 car parking, a sizable storage area, and a large shared backyard. Just steps from your door are some of the best restaurants, cafes and shops on the Clement Street corridor including Lokma, Tia Margarita, Big Fish House, Fiorella, Home Coffee Roasters, and the Clement Nursery just to name a few. The whole building is also for sale (263-265 19th Ave). Don't miss out on your chance at this wonderful opportunity!
